image_description: A close-up view of a beige adhesive bandage (Band-Aid) applied to human skin, likely a finger. The bandage features a custom hand-drawn illustration in black ink resembling a cartoon character or creature with red accents, along with a horizontal black line and red zigzag marks. Two human fingertips are visible pressing down on the right side of the bandage.
